npmPackages.name: @dignite/ng.flex-fields
npmPackages.note: Direct dependency of @dignite/ng.site (installed with it) from public npmjs. Must resolve to exactly one copy in the host's tree: FLEX_FIELD_TYPES is a module-scoped InjectionToken, so a second copy is a second DI key and the field types registered against one are invisible to the resolver reading the other - absent at runtime, with nothing failing at install or build time.
